description.text: What is the day of the week on 29th May,2002?

properties.html: What is the day of the week on 29th May, 2002?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

2000 – century ………… no of odd days = 0
Extra 2 years ……………..no of odd days = 1 (always considering 1 less)
Up to 29th May from January, no of odd days = (3+0+3+2+29) ….. 2
Therefore, total odd days = (0+1+2) = 3
So, 3rd day of the week is 29th May, 2002 i.e. Wednesday.

Explanation:

                  Month           Year
                  5th February, 2019 = Sunday
                23rd October, 2021 =                         
Odd Days - (2+3+2+3+ 2+3+3+2+2)     (2+1)

Total            (+4)
so, answer is = Sunday + 4 odd days = Thursday

description.text: What was the day of the week on 17th August, 2018?

properties.html: What was the day of the week on 17th August, 2018?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

2000 – century …………… odd days = 0
Extra 18 years……………….odd days = (17+4) = 21 i.e. 0
Up to 17th August from January……..Odd days = (3+0+3+2+3+2+3+17) = 5
Total odd days = (0+0+5) = 5
So, 17th August, 2018 was 5th day of the week i.e. Friday.

description.text: What was the day of the week on 15th March, 2015?

properties.html: What was the day of the week on 15th March, 2015?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

2000 century……………. No of odd days = 0
Extra 15 years ………….No of odd days = (14 + 3) = 17 or 3
Up to 15th March from January…….no of odd days = (3+0+15) = 18 or 4
Total odd days = ( 0+3+4) = 7 or 0
So, 15th March, 2015 was 7th day of the week or the 0th day of the week i.e. Sunday.

description.text: If, 25th April 1993 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 10th August 1985?

properties.html: If, 25th April 1993 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 10th August 1985?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

                Month           Year
                25th April,      1993 = Saturday
                10th August,  1985                      
Odd days - (5+3+2+3 +10)  {-(8+2)}
                      (+2)                    (-3)
Total -            (-1)
So, 10th August, 1985 was = Saturday – 1 odd day = Friday.

properties.html: If Leap year comes in every second year, instead of every fourth year, then what will be the day of the week on 1st January 2051, if 1st January 2020 is Saturday?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Month
1st January, 2020 = Saturday
1st January, 2051 =

description.text: What was the day of the week on 12th March, 2009, if 1st January, 2008 was Tuesday?

properties.html: What was the day of the week on 12th March, 2009, if 1st January, 2008 was Tuesday?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

1st January, 2008 = Tuesday;
therefore 1st January, 2009 = Tuesday + 1 odd day = Wednesday
Now, from 1st January, 2009 to 12th March, 2009 – no of odd days = (2+0+12) = 14 or 0
So, 12th March, 2009 was = Wednesday + 0 odd day = Wednesday.

description.text: If a week consists of 8 days, instead of 7 days and the 8th day being a new day between Wednesday and Thursday, what will be the day of the week on 1st January 2025, if 1st January 2018 was Monday?

properties.html: If a week consists of 8 days, instead of 7 days and the 8th day being a new day between Wednesday and Thursday, what will be the day of the week on 1st January 2025, if 1st January 2018 was Monday?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Now, odd days in a normal year = 365/8 … … … 5 odd days
Odd days in a Leap year = 366/8 … … … 6 odd days (1 extra odd day)
1st January, 2018 to 1st January, 2025……… no of odd days ( 7*5 + 2*1) = 37 or 37/8 … … … 5 odd days
So, 1st January, 2025 will be = Monday + 5 odd days = Friday
